cincinnati-museum-center.cognitive.2.text: A caregiver visiting to support a person with a disability can receive a free Museum Admission ticket at the box office. The museum says caregivers still pay for OMNIMAX and featured exhibits.
cincinnati-museum-center.cognitive.2.quote: Caregivers, who are visiting the museum for the purpose of providing care to an Individual with Disabilities, will be able to receive a free, complementary Museum Admission ticket. The caregiver will need to visit the box office to receive their ticket. As a reminder, the caregiver comp ticket only applies to the Museum Admission ticket. Caregivers will need to pay to visit OMNIMAX ® and Featured Exhibits.
cincinnati-museum-center.cognitive.2.reason: Restored the box-office collection requirement and the explicit exclusion of OMNIMAX and featured exhibits from the free caregiver ticket.
